questions.prompt: In the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm, what is the order of the two passes?
options: Backward pass tip-to-base accumulating forces first, then a forward pass computing motion
Both computations in one single pass from base to tip, so no second pass is needed
A backward pass only, because accelerations are not needed to find joint torques
Forward pass base-to-tip computing motion, then backward pass tip-to-base accumulating forces
questions.explanation: Accelerations propagate outward; forces needed to produce them accumulate inward.

questions.prompt: Which statement about the inertial parameters of a robot arm is correct?
options: Torque is nonlinear in the inertial parameters, so they cannot be fit by linear least squares
Parameters can be identified from a single sample if the measurement noise is small
